records.section_heading: Summer Coral Bleaching Event, 2004, on Tutuila, American Samoa
records.question: Which three lagoons had significant amounts of bleached staghorn corals in 2004?
ground_truth_chunks: A total of 5 areas had significant proportions of dead staghorn, Airport, Nuuuli, Alofau, Faga'alu and Utelei.
Three of these had significant amounts of bleached staghorns: Airport, Nuuuli, and Alofau.
